verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for an OS that exposes developer APIs such as the Windows App SDK and Win32, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no documentation of API versioning or a published deprecation policy. The UWP-to-Windows App SDK migration guidance, the Windows 10 ESU lifecycle program and the app-compatibility claims are adjacent features, not a documented API deprecation policy, so they earn no credit.
